name: Love Triangle: Begin Again...
source:
You were once a soccer star on track for the Olympics, but now an ordinary person with a sad past that is haunting you
You decide to refresh your life, discover new hobbies, new friends, new dreams in a town full of characters, and perhaps even find love on your journey...
Will you fall into the arms of the mysterious dojo instructor who never seems to miss a beat?
Or the theatrical cafe owner with big smiles?
That's for you to decide...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.hanabimedia.android_visualnovelloveheals]Google Play[/url]]
